name: Far Fresnel
storyline:
FAR FRESNEL is a survival exploration game where you descend into the abyss of LHS-1140-B, a distant and hostile planet, aboard an ancient elevator system.

As you venture deeper into this forsaken world, you'll learn to master your environment, solve puzzles, and put the light on the CHIONE expeditions. With each level, the danger increases, and your only hope of survival is to keep descending.
FAR FRESNEL is a test of your mind, your sanity, your very will to survive in a hostile and forgotten world. Learn how to fix and control the elevator, find the secrets hidden inside its walls. Look for traces of the previous expeditions scattered accross the environment using a modified version of the Remote Explorer supplied by Nạ̃oVivo Corp

Will you survive long enough to reveal the secrets buried deep below the surface?
summary: FAR FRESNEL is an exploration game where you descend into the abyss of a distant planet aboard an ancient elevator system. As you venture deeper into this forsaken world, you'll uncover the secrets of the previous expeditions.
